children: Natera will use its Signatera MRD test to identify colorectal cancer patients for TransCode’s Phase 2a TTX-MC138 trial in the PRE-I-SPY program.
Signatera to screen MRD+ CRC patients
Could drive test utilization and validate MRD-guided therapy pathways, a potential volume and payer catalyst for Natera.
Positions Natera at the center of a novel therapy trial; success could embed Signatera in treatment decisions.
Highlights earlier-stage intervention where MRD tests are most actionable, supporting clinical relevance.
Accelerated platform may speed enrollment/readouts, tightening potential timelines for validation.
Expands platform visibility; CRC is a large market where MRD adoption could be significant.

This is an early-stage strategic move to tie Signatera to an interventional CRC trial, extending MRD use beyond detection. A catalyst requires strong Phase 2a signals and evidence that MRD-guided treatment improves outcomes, leading to guideline and payer adoption.
